title: Hoja de ánimas · notas y escenario
description: The ánimas' sheet as just animas serves it (output/reports/animas/, written again on each load by animasSheet in vite.config.ts): an ánima's design beside what the game has, with its notes in the rail on the right, written, edited and closed there, about the whole page or one row (✎) and with what they ask to change; the Notas page gathers them all. Above the notes, the stage: ▶ on a skill, a dual, a status or a reaction plays it in a real fight in a frame (/?anima-demo, src/anima-demo.ts). It writes to output/reports/animas/notes-scratch.json (?notas=scratch), never to docs/anima-notes.json, and empties it at the end. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: fetch('/__animas/notas?archivo=scratch', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ notes: [{ id: 'n-a1', entry: 'papagato', name: 'Papagato', text: 'La tabla de habilidades no dice cuántas heridas hacen falta para el golpe crítico. Ponlo en el diseño.', status: 'hecha', created: '2026-11-20T09:10:00Z', closed: '2026-11-20T09:40:00Z', reply: 'Añadido en § Signature: el golpe crítico salta con 3 heridas abiertas, con el ejemplo de una ronda.' }, { id: 'n-a2', entry: 'duos', name: 'Dúos', text: 'Falta una pareja para Dadaísta que no sea con Matemágico.', status: 'abierta', created: '2026-11-20T09:20:00Z' }] }) })

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('#notes [data-draft]'); t.focus(); t.value = 'Ronroneo cura poco para lo que cuesta: compáralo con la cura de Matemágico.'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.caption: ✎ on Zarpazos: the note is about that skill (× makes it about the page again) and asks to change its animation

▶ on Zarpazos plays it in the stage: the game in a frame, Gerard at 35 and Aitor against three dogs, the skill done by the fight's own rules; the row is lit, its note marked ✎ 1 and tagged in the rail
A click on the stage enlarges it over the page, playing the dual Zarpazos de fuego (Matemágico on Gerard, Papagato on Aitor) with its banner; another click or Esc gives the page back
→ in the enlarged stage plays the next dual of the page (← the one before), without leaving it
Mecánicas compartidas: how each status and reaction looks in the game, ▶ puts it on the middle dog (here Vapor: Mojado, then fire)
